title: Citadel Protocol
description: A covert Spectre rootkit has subverted kernel memory and corrupted Merkle audit leaves. Neutralize rogue hooks, trap hostile execution threads in ephemeral sandboxes, and seal the Citadel.
briefing: Kernel integrity alerts indicate corrupted ledger states and deep memory tampering. Audit the Merkle tree to find the divergent leaf hash, expose the rootkit descriptor, deploy an ephemeral zero-trust sandbox, purge hostile kernel hooks, and submit the citadel containment report.

objectives.title: Audit Merkle ledger integrity
objectives.description: Scan cryptographic Merkle verification tree and detect divergent leaf hash.

objectives.title: Trace and identify rootkit
objectives.description: Trace memory hooks and expose active Spectre rootkit descriptor.

objectives.title: Deploy ephemeral sandbox
objectives.description: Trap rootkit execution threads inside a zero-trust ephemeral micro-sandbox.

objectives.title: Purge rootkit hooks
objectives.description: Execute cryptographic kernel purge and sever rogue driver hooks.

objectives.title: Submit citadel report
objectives.description: Document full containment and submit final report to Aegis Command.
